- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. - update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

Run before committing nontrivial changes; bootstraps this repo's project verify skill if none exists yet. Don't invoke it on a diff that only touches tests, docs, or other code with no runtime surface to drive (a change to product source always has one) — there's nothing to observe.
- code-review: Review the current diff for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings; ultra: deep multi-agent review in the cloud). Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.

use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Http\Controllers\AssetServeController;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

/*
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------
| Route del package digital-hub
|--------------------------------------------------------------------------
|
| Caricate dal DigitalHubServiceProvider. Stanno nel gruppo middleware "web"
| così la sessione (e quindi l'utente autenticato del pannello) è disponibile
| per il serving gated degli asset (22d, design §7.10).
|

Route::middleware('web')->group(function (): void {
    // Download multiplo come zip in streaming (22e). Accesso via token
    // server-side (AssetShare): il token è il segreto, il controller verifica la
    // scadenza. Stessa rotta riusata dalla condivisione esterna (22g). Va
    // registrata PRIMA di assets/{media} per non essere intercettata.
    Route::get('assets/share/{token}/download', [AssetServeController::class, 'downloadShareZip'])
        ->name('digital-hub.assets.share-download');

    // Serving gated degli asset su disco privato (22d). {media} = id del Media.
    Route::get('assets/{media}', [AssetServeController::class, 'show'])
        ->whereNumber('media')
        ->name('digital-hub.assets.show');

    Route::get('assets/{media}/preview', [AssetServeController::class, 'preview'])
        ->whereNumber('media')
        ->name('digital-hub.assets.preview');
});

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Http\Controllers;

use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Models\AssetShare;
use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Support\AssetPreview;
use AtrioTeam\DigitalHub\Assets\Support\AssetZip;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Spatie\MediaLibrary\MediaCollections\Models\Media;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

/**
 * Serving gated degli asset (digital-hub 22d, design §7.10).
 *
 * Gli asset vivono su disco PRIVATO (non esposto via symlink/URL pubblico):
 * ogni accesso al file passa di qui, che decide chi può vederlo. Due rami di
 * autorizzazione (design §7.10):
 *
 *  1. Richiesta firmata (signed URL temporaneo) → accesso concesso dalla firma
 *     stessa. È il meccanismo per l'embedding senza sessione e per la
 *     condivisione esterna (22g, gallery `/share/{token}` con token proprio).
 *  2. Utente autenticato nel pannello → si applica la policy sul proprietario
 *     dell'asset quando esiste (authz interna §7.1: A+B nativi, C on demand).
 *     Senza policy registrata sul proprietario, basta l'autenticazione.
 *
 * Il file è servito inline. Per i dischi locali si usa una BinaryFileResponse
 * (supporta le Range request → seeking di video/audio); per dischi remoti si
 * ricade sullo stream del filesystem.
 */
class AssetServeController
{
    /** Serve il file originale dell'asset. */
    public function show(Request $request, Media $media): Response
    {
        $this->authorizeAccess($request, $media);

        return $this->serve($media, $media->getPathRelativeToRoot(), $media->mime_type);
    }

    /**
     * Download multiplo come zip in streaming (22e). L'accesso è dato dal token
     * dello {@see AssetShare}: il token è il segreto, qui si verifica solo che lo
     * share esista e non sia scaduto. Streaming vero verso il browser, senza
     * buffering Livewire. Stessa rotta usata dalla condivisione esterna (22g).
     */
    public function downloadShareZip(string $token): StreamedResponse
    {
        $share = AssetShare::query()->where('token', $token)->first();
        abort_if($share === null || $share->isExpired(), 404);

        // share protetto da password (22g): scaricabile solo dopo lo sblocco nella
        // gallery (gate condiviso via sessione, design §7.10). Gli share effimeri del
        // download multiplo (22e) non hanno password → nessun gate.
        abort_if($share->hasPassword() && session()->get($share->sessionUnlockKey()) !== true, 403);

        $media = $share->media()->get();
        abort_if($media->isEmpty(), 404);

        $name = 'assets-' . now()->format('Ymd-His') . '.zip';

        return AssetZip::streamResponse($media, $name);
    }

    /** Serve il poster/anteprima generato per l'asset (404 se assente). */
    public function preview(Request $request, Media $media): Response
    {
        $this->authorizeAccess($request, $media);

        $path = $media->getCustomProperty(AssetPreview::PROPERTY);
        abort_unless(is_string($path) && $path !== '', 404);

        return $this->serve($media, $path, 'image/jpeg');
    }

    /**
     * Autorizza l'accesso al media. Vedi i due rami descritti sul controller.
     */
    private function authorizeAccess(Request $request, Media $media): void
    {
        if ($request->hasValidSignature()) {
            return;
        }

        $user = $request->user();
        abort_if($user === null, 403);

        // Proprietario morph dell'asset (es. Product). Si applica la sua policy
        // solo se ne esiste una registrata: il core non impone authz per-record,
        // la abilita quando il template la fornisce (shield / policy custom).
        $owner = $media->model;
        if ($owner !== null && Gate::getPolicyFor($owner) !== null) {
            abort_if(Gate::forUser($user)->denies('view', $owner), 403);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Risposta inline per un path relativo al disco del media. Usa una
     * BinaryFileResponse (Range/seeking) sui dischi locali, lo stream del
     * filesystem altrimenti.
     */
    private function serve(Media $media, string $relativePath, ?string $mime): Response
    {
        $disk = Storage::disk($media->disk);
        abort_unless($disk->exists($relativePath), 404);

        $headers = $mime !== null ? ['Content-Type' => $mime] : [];

        // Disco locale: path assoluto risolvibile a un file reale → BinaryFileResponse,
        // che gestisce nativamente le Range request (seeking video/audio). Su dischi
        // remoti (es. s3) il path non è un file locale → stream del filesystem.
        $absolute = $disk->path($relativePath);
        if (is_file($absolute)) {
            return response()->file($absolute, $headers);
        }

        return $disk->response($relativePath, $media->file_name, $headers, 'inline');
    }
}
